about: Cedeño Law Group works from Broadway and names three people, among them Peter L. Cedeño. It publishes in Spanish and says it does collaborative divorce as well as litigation.

168 reviews at 4.7. It names one stage of a matrimonial case, which is the thinnest explanation in this ranking, and publishes nothing about the rate or the retainer. Its largest contentful paint on mobile is 10.3 seconds.

G2.evidence: None of the 2 named attorneys carries a disciplinary status on the public register: no disbarment, suspension or disciplinary resignation. Those statuses persist, so the check reaches back years, but it would not show a censure or a suspension since lifted.

G3.evidence: No matching entity found in the active corporations register. New York does not require a general partnership to file with the Department of State, so this is not evidence against the firm, only a check we could not complete from this source

G3.unresolvable: New York does not require every law firm to file with the Department of State, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 3 named attorneys published.

G6.evidence: 168 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2011-10-06, so it has been operating for more than a year
